WITH raw_lots AS (
    SELECT
        lots.*,

        CASE
            WHEN LOCATE(
                'Почтовый адрес ориентира:',
                nspd_address
            ) > 0
            THEN SUBSTRING(
                nspd_address,
                LOCATE(
                    'Почтовый адрес ориентира:',
                    nspd_address
                ) + CHAR_LENGTH('Почтовый адрес ориентира:')
            )
            ELSE nspd_address
        END AS source_address

    FROM lots
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
      AND center_latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND center_longitude IS NOT NULL
),

prepared_lots AS (
    SELECT
        raw_lots.*,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(
                REGEXP_REPLACE(
                    REGEXP_REPLACE(
                        REGEXP_REPLACE(
                            source_address,
                            '^(Адрес( земельного участка| участка)?|Местоположение( земельного участка)?)[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*',
                            ''
                        ),
                        '[,;.][[:space:]]*(Земельный участок|Участок)[[:space:]]+(расположен|находится).*$',
                        ''
                    ),
                    '[[:space:]]+',
                    ' '
                )
            ),
            ''
        ) AS clean_address

    FROM raw_lots
)

SELECT
    lot_key AS primary_id,
    cadastral_number,

    CONCAT(
        center_latitude,
        ', ',
        center_longitude
    ) AS coordinates,

    clean_address AS address,

    CASE transaction_type
        WHEN 'sale' THEN 'Продажа'
        WHEN 'rent' THEN 'Аренда'
        ELSE transaction_type
    END AS auction_type,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            JSON_UNQUOTE(
                JSON_EXTRACT(
                    normalized_json,
                    '$.lot_description'
                )
            ),
            ''
        ),
        NULLIF(lot_name, '')
    ) AS description,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            JSON_UNQUOTE(
                JSON_EXTRACT(
                    normalized_json,
                    '$.category_name'
                )
            ),
            ''
        ),
        CASE
            WHEN category_code = '301'
            THEN 'Земли населенных пунктов'
            ELSE NULL
        END
    ) AS land_category,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(nspd_permitted_use), ''),
        NULLIF(
            TRIM(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(
                            permitted_use_names_json,
                            '"',
                            ''
                        ),
                        '[',
                        ''
                    ),
                    ']',
                    ''
                )
            ),
            ''
        )
    ) AS permitted_use,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(nspd_area_m2, ''),
        NULLIF(area_m2, '')
    ) AS area_m2,

    CAST(start_price AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS start_price,
    NULLIF(application_deadline, '') AS application_deadline

FROM prepared_lots
WHERE clean_address IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(start_price), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(start_price AS DECIMAL(20,2)) > 0

ORDER BY cadastral_number;
